reviews.text: Coco loves when he cuts her nails! She’s tiny and squirmy but he’s so great with her! We’ve been going there for many years as it’s hard to find such good service for a good price! Thank you 🐶
Amazing service!!

My dogs and I have been coming to this shop since it opened. Love the vibe and no matter what we go in for — food, nail trim, coats, collar, leashes, to name a just a few things — Farrell finds exactly what we need. He can size up a dog for a perfectly sized coat and see if they need a nail trim. Every time my pup wears her beautiful bright yellow raincoat people love it and ask where I got it. It's so styling! Love that the shop is locally owned and the owner truly cares and is very knowledgeable about dogs and cats.

My dog had a great experience with Ferrell! He was very attentive and listened to my request for a cut for my dog and delivered. He even made a cute video of the progress. I'll be back if we ever need a groomer while in Vancouver!

Have been going to EZ Dog for well over a year now for my large breed’s (Husky/Rottweiler) nail trimming and paw tidy needs. The owner is very patient and capable with big breeds like my dog, Change, and is able to work through his anxieties super well. I’m so happy I found EZ Dog and recommend for all dogs but if you’re dog is a large breed with anxieties etc you’ll be well served and your dog will be in great care!

My dog loves it here and so do I! Ferrel is very knowledgeable, understanding and helpful. Every dog is clearly so well cared for & he makes sure everyone is happy before you leave. I would absolutely recommend anyone take their dog here :)

We have been taking our dog to EZ dog for grooming for a few years. We are always really happy with the results and the owner is  great with handling our anxious dog. Recently, we have been using EZ dog for overnight boarding when we go away. The owner of EZ dog made us feel very comfortable trusting our dog with him. It’s not like a regular kennel where he’s locked up, he gets more attention and gets to be in their home. I know our dog is in good hands while we are away and I will continue to use his services!! I highly recommend EZ dog for both grooming and boarding services.
Great experience here! We were able to leave our two pups with Farrell while we had lunch around the area. I’ll definitely consider coming back for grooming needs and other pet supplies.

Came here at the begining of the month for my dog's spa day, walked right in the gentleman was so helpful.   So reassuring as I felt because of my handicap I felt ashamed for letting my dogs hair get a little too long.  Her hair cut was quick got a call shortly after dropping her off came to pick her up she was so happy.  Just walked intoday to see the gentleman again and get Honey (my dog) a toy; so helpful with that and again he was so friendly while talking he gave me information about my dogs tear lines (I am sure there is a name for it but you catch my drift).  Came on here to write a review for turned around to there website wow I might have to try their training lessons or take advantage of daycare(might need a day to myself who knows) wow all this right around the corner from my place wow.   I so recommend this place I've had a great experience!!!
Recently took my 11 month old basset hound puppy for grooming, nail trim & ear cleaning. Very Happy with the service, great prices. Will definitely be a repeat customer.
Always the best service, my dog loves him - and he’s usually so scared of the groomer
Top notch grooming!
Both my dogs love getting groomed here and when needing daycare or boarding they always come home happy and well taken care of.
My dachshund is very wiggly and nervous getting her nails done, he did a great job with her. I will come back and would recommend!
Great experience taking my cavalier here. I really like the groom he got and I’ll come back again. Also a great place to pick up pet supplies on the east side of town. Would recommend.

I used to love this pet store and they took care if all my dogs needs
But in the last few years I can never get her dog food in stick or her must hav treats they are never in stick anymore and that's disappointing

My wife and I have a 2-year-old Cocker Spaniel. We were recently on vacation in Vancouver's China Town area with the dog. During our walk about in China Town, we came upon a dog grooming facility. Upon entering the dog grooming store, we met Farrel. His expertise and energy were very noticeable. My wife and I felt very comfortable after a brief conversation with Farrel. You could tell that Farrel loves dogs and actually told us he had six of them himself. Our dog received its first real grooming since we owned her. We were thrilled with the work that Farrel did and highly recommend anyone seeking grooming services to use this facility in China Town. We will certainly stop in and use his grooming services again. Our rating of this business is 10 out of 10.  Thanks so much!  All the best!

Judgmental, minimal effort to find the type of dog food I was looking for. Considering I wasn't allowed in the store, you'd think the service would be better. If I'm not able to enter next time, I will be lowering my rating.
I left feeling dismissed and as if I were treated differently due to potential economic class differences (considering the area.... They need to get over that part).
The food I left with wasn't anything close to what my pup usually eats. She isn't really a fan of it and it's upsetting her stomach. Thanks for the lazy judgmental treatment guys!

By far the best grooming experience I've taken my dog to.
Farrell's love for animals and attention to detail shines through in his service and I've never felt more comfortable sending my dog to a space unaccompanied.
21 out of 10 I recommend.
Absolutely AMAZING! Every time we take our 4yr Chihuahua, Bully, in for bath and nail clip, Farrell is always so happy and calm and really puts our dog at ease. Wonderful service!
Now called The Dog Shop!
We stop by annually for our dog to get properly cleaned up. The owner is always friendly, responsive, and gets us in quickly.

Vancouver's version of the dog whisperer sans the animal abuse allegations I bring my Mazie there and she goes in looking like any other pitty from Vancouver and comes out looking like the queen of the dtes. He don't leave out a thing even tossing her a treat on the house. I'm so greatful that he keeps his talents down here cause there those like me who really care about their best friend.
Farrel is a such a great shop owner, I trust him with my puppy! :)
The Dogfather is who you want grooming your dog! Best dog groomer in the city!

My 14 years old indoor kitty Bear is so skittish, Farrel is literally an animal whisperer, never gonna waste my time trying to groom my cats myself again. Can’t believe how smooth and efficiently things went with Bear. Thanks Farrel, wish I’d come sooner.

Farrell is great. My dog has been going to him since she was 5 months old. The dogs know who is in charge, which is the most important thing at a daycare. Send your puppies to him and they will be part of the pack, well mannered & desensitized quickly

DISGUSTING AND TERRIBLE!!! I took my dog for a nail trim, this guy, besides the fact he looks like a homeless, didn’t even let me see and took my dog from me, I heard my dog scream and cry, when he got back my dog was bleeding from at least 3 nails!!!!! Don’t do this to your furry kids, I only payed because I’m not the type of person to just go away without paying but truly, what an HORROR!!! This guy claims he’s done this for 15 years, well my dog hadn’t bled like this EVER. Besides the nails are now cricked and with irregular pointy ends!!!!! And he is still bleeding now at home!!!!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ok first, stop sending me insulting messages to my PERSONAL number, I don’t think that's even permitted for a business to harass customers using their personal info.

And actually when we got there I was nice to you and kindly asked if I could be present because my dog is a rescue and a senior, he’s 11 yo, I picked him from the streets a few year ago and he is very anxious and nervious in situations when strangers have to touch him to perform any kind of procedure on him, so what I do is I talk to him to calm him down. You refused and I didn’t say anything just okay and surely wasn’t rude to you. But in 6 years my dog had NEVER bled from a nail trim this bad! because people performing this are actual professionals and are trained to do it, unlike you that don’t even acknowledge what a danger you are, because you weren’t careful with the veins, which you have to avoid trimming so dogs don’t BLEED. My dog, as anxious as he is had never bled and had never had his nails trimmed so BAD like you did, because actual professionals did it! Of course the solution to an anxious dog is NOT to trim his nails deeper!! That’s just torture, he was still bleeding when we got home! So you hurt him so bad that the bleeding didn’t stop right away (and I have proof) and you didn’t even put ANYTHING on him to try to stop the bleeding, which if you were a bit smart, would have done and would have been prepared with, he was crying when you were doing the trimming and suffering because I could HEAR him! Also he had tears in his eyes. Of course I was and still am UPSET.

And actually as soon as you started petting him when we arrived he started trembling, he does not do that actually with almost anybody, because he likes people a lot, but he did with you which tells me more you could ever do. I thought that this place had a professional team because of the reviews, that would have actually KNOWN how to CONTROL the situation, but of course you’re not even trained to offer these type of services and you don’t even care since you prefer to be fighting with me for the review than to acknowledge and actually learn to do your “job”, I really wonder if you at least have a license or something??

And regarding my parents, you are a nobody to be talking about them but well, at least they taught me to SHOWER and treat animals with respect and actually care for their well-being, unlike yours.

Anyways, hope my 20 dollars help you in some way and that you at least take something from this like the willingness to take a course or something to actually learn to do this and not hurt more poor animals! I will take something from this, which is to not trust people like you and always verify that people performing anything on my dog are professionals and not just call themselves that.

Farrell never complains about my reactive dog and always delivers him looking and smelling better. Reasonably priced and clean establishment. I've already been about 5x and plan on making this my regular dog groomer.

Farrel  has been taking care of my Poms for over ten years and he’s the absolute best. Super calm energy, always accommodating to my hectic schedule, easy going and of course excellent care. My dogs love their visits to EZ Dog.
Did a wonderful job grooming my dog.

Farrell has been great for our dog Rico. His team of great looking dogs create a great environment for out reactive pet.
Farrell has boarded Rico and has given him the skills to slow down and meet new people. I could not be happier with his service.

We are so happy with the boarding and daycare at Ezdog. We took our dog Rico there for training on his reactive behaviour. Farrel has been amazing in working with him. He has also boarded Rico for a week and Rico enjoyed his time with him and the other dogs.
Great place to take your fur baby they are very gentle with the animals an the do an awesome job grooming your fur baby
Excelente work and service
